topic: How does nonlinear power amplifier operation influence payload power management during EE-maximizing precoding?
response: Nonlinear power amplifier operation introduces intermodulation products and nonlinearity, which degrade signal quality. To mitigate this, EE-maximizing precoding algorithms can be employed to optimize transmit power distribution while considering nonlinear effects as additional noise. This approach enables efficient use of power resources while maintaining acceptable signal-to-noise ratios.
reference_context: The context discusses the impact of nonlinear power amplifier operation on satellite communications, including intermodulation products and nonlinearity. EE-maximizing precoding is proposed to optimize transmit power distribution, considering nonlinear effects as additional noise.
